business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

children-education-faster.title: Mentioning the education of children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-education-faster.body: Pitches that reference children's schooling or educational needs tend to accelerate funding for both male and female borrowers.

female-repayment-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their past loan repayment history fund faster.
female-repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference a successful history of repaying previous loans are associated with increased funding speed.

female-family-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention securing their family's future may fund faster.

male-community-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention contributing to the well-being of the local community may fund more slowly.

female-age-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their age may fund faster.

female-work-hours-faster.body: Female borrowers who provide specific daily work hours may fund faster.

female-nwtf-help-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention receiving previous help from NWTF loans may fund more slowly.

female-thanking-lenders-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly thank the lenders in their pitch may fund faster.

female-financial-training-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific training in financial management or record-keeping may fund faster.

female-smartphone-purchase-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the purchase of a smartphone may fund faster.

female-dual-use-tool-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention tools used for both business and education may fund faster.

female-business-growth-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention growing, developing, or expanding their business may fund faster.

female-children-count-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the specific number of children may fund more slowly.
female-children-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying number of children predicts faster funding.

female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap and subsumed by general repayment history claim.

female-hardworking-hyphen-faster.title: Female borrowers who use the word 'hardworking' without a hyphen may fund faster.
female-hardworking-hyphen-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' predicts slower funding.

female-town-centre-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their business is located in the town centre may fund faster.

female-existing-demand-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention existing customer orders or demand may fund faster.
female-existing-demand-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to maintain puzzle cap

female-community-environment-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention environmental protection or their neighbors may fund faster.

female-inventory-listing-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific inventory or materials may fund faster.
female-inventory-listing-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that listing specific categories of inventory or inputs predicts slower funding for women.

female-expansion-dream-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a dream to expand their business may fund faster.

female-descriptive-adjectives-slower.title: Female borrowers who use descriptive adjectives like 'hardworking' or 'dedicated' may fund more slowly.

female-children-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children may fund faster.
female-children-count-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed family demographics, including child count, predict slower funding.
